analysis.summary: Technical review of UI description saving issue reported by Customer A at Willowfield Trust. Screen-sharing session confirmed that event-payment descriptions fail to persist after saving, reverting to earlier wording. Team member confirmed reproduction of the bug.
analysis.why_it_matters: Reproduced software defect in core transaction editing workflow affecting audit compliance at a trust advisory customer.

evidence.quote: The first one is editing the description. I am changing this event-payment description to a short reference.
evidence.reason: Customer demonstrates the exact transaction edit attempted.

evidence.quote: The field still shows the earlier wording. So the change is not appearing after you save, is that right?
evidence.reason: SpendNest team member verifies and acknowledges persistence bug.

not_established: Engineering root cause (frontend cache vs database update failure).
Target patch release date for the transaction editing bug.

recommended_actions.action: File urgent engineering defect ticket with screen-recording reproduction details.
Notify Customer A once hotfix is deployed to staging.
